notes.title: Origami Solutions | Early Access
notes.content:
Hi!

We are so excited to share what we have been working on! From the developer of "Memories of East Coast" and "I'm A Pencil", Origami Solutions is a new project by Roomah Gaming.


 Early Access:The visual novel is still in its early development. 
 Work In Progress: We've released a demo that you can try out!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/4f0d88c9c88125912147e91cedb6fa069f04694f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/2369afbecbfe90764eca54b3709e5b6ae7936cd0.png

Embark on a gripping tale of loyalty, betrayal, and family ties as you guide Adam through a world of power struggles and moral complexities. Uncover dark secrets, navigate intricate relationships, and witness the consequences of every choice, shaping not only Adam's destiny but the fate of those entangled in the web of secrecy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/f2f4695f9cf8899cee1137c57d2490fae083259e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/859047c0fb2690f9d5948092b014a51111c9c0fa.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/2f1c3dd186d1956a6a0282c00a342af360e168e5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/70f4b515587aa9f251c109e09b7440508cf9f463.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/268026e387b4cf4a62142f37804c56e8adbad35d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/0029060183846a86deae9417bb9e51512218d1d6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/4116cefd9dd7a43494f46af5a6862c4e15a7090c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/b19aa613fe832e7925bb6c164126ff15493560c1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/8458653215fb37d3925f0a042a914450dbf708a1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/0e2da0b6c251d4cc14cbc8755529eb189fdf4d96.png

: : DOWNLOAD : :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/a4d7885b5ccf706d16226657192b26d10c93ef82.png

Dynamic Decision-Making: Shape Adam's destiny in a riveting narrative with personalized outcomes.
Intricate Character Relationships: Navigate complex bonds with Adam, Edward, and allies for a unique, emotionally resonant journey.
Reveal Dark Secrets: Uncover hidden truths about Adam's father and Origami's inner workings.
Multiple Endings: Experience impactful resolutions with myriad choices, shaping Adam's fate and Origami's future.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/2e8725034a04d3395198421f4dbb7b3a0663726b.png

: : DOWNLOAD : :

If you have any suggestions, please reach us out.
We are looking forward to delivering only the best experience!

Thank you in advance!

Link to the game: https://roomahgaming.itch.io/origami-solutions

Early Access Launch: : : DOWNLOAD : :
Version 0.1.00: November 26th, 2023

Regards,
Roomah Gaming

notes.content:

Hello, players!

Celebrate your holiday with tons of games!
Are you up for an adventure? Perhaps some actions? Or maybe you like to be sneaky and use stealth approach? Do you happen to like puzzle though? Oh, ho-ho-ho, good news, you can experience all these in this big bundle!

Why big bundle? Good question. Hundreds of hidden gems were carefully mined and collected from multiple different developers! Each of them works passionately in delivering their masterpiece in which everyone should check it out! ^^

Buy BIG BUNDLE to save 80% off all 454 items!

Love & roses, 
Roomah Gaming

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/dad03aab0617c2c028634ddcde150eafd0d296af.png

Hello, readers!

February 21st, 2022 marked the 1-year anniversary of "Memories of East Coast".
We may not know each other in person, but the memories are real. Thank you for the love and support.

Let's continue creating sweet memories! ^^

Love & roses, 
Roomah Gaming

notes.title: We're among the finalists for the GDWC Fan-Favorite Award!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/ead4febe44fdef992267ff223e14707ea308e428.png

Hello, readers!

Together with you, we have become among the finalists for the Game Development World Championship.
We manage to bring "Memories of East Coast" forward into the final round. We can't thank you enough for the support you had given us! We wish you all happy life!

The voting is now live. You may cast your vote from now until Monday, January 31 morning at 10:00 AM Finnish time GMT+2.

Cast your vote here (no registration required!):
I'm voting now!

Let's continue creating sweet memories! ^^

Love & roses, 
Roomah Gaming

notes.title: Coming to consoles!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/70df3a429a9347c6145f0a6c41580bbe46ecb437.jpg 

Hello, readers!

We are taking a big step!
We manage to bring "Memories of East Coast" onto Playstation 4, Playstation 5, and Nintendo Switch! Thanks to our publisher EastAsiaSoft and our working partner Ratalaika Games for realizing our dreams! While, of course, to you, our beloved readers, we can't thank you enough for the support you had given us! We wish you all happy holidays!

Let's continue creating sweet memories! ^^

Love & roses, 
Roomah Gaming

notes.title: GDWC Fan-Favorite Awards
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529042/fb52b57f631aab932e41620463d905bedbddf8cc.png

Hello, readers!

The weekly voting period has ended. We did it!
Thank you for your votes & support. "Memories of East Coast" won in last week's GDWC fan-favorite awards, we're moving on to the finals! We wouldn't make it without you, we appreciate all the love and support you had given us!

If you enjoyed the visual novel, consider spreading the word with your friends! Write your thoughts upon the visual novel to help us to be ever-improving in the future!

Have a wonderful day/evening! ^^

Love & roses, 
Roomah Gaming

notes.content:

Hello, readers!
It's wonderful to see you here. 

Game Development World Championship - GDWC (2021)

notes.content:
Memories of East Coast | 100% Discount SALE

[previewyoutube=OElyc4sDkFA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for the support we received since our first journey on itch.io. We appreciate all the support and feedback we received. It has been a great memory. As the developer myself, a writer and the owner of both visual novels; "Memories of East Coast" and "I'm A Pencil", we are giving away "Memories of East Coast" on itch.io from May 26, 2021 until June 1, 2021.

Steam planned release date; June, 2021.

SALE was done for promotional purposes.

Thank you,
Roomah Gaming
